title: Text task request with explicit bridge correlation
purpose: Illustrate a minimal OIX task.request payload that a separately specified bridge could map to an A2A SendMessage request. This is not a protocol-level direct mapping.

payload.text: Summarize the public document at https://example.org/sample in three bullet points.

input.note: Envelope is illustrative only: signature, key, fingerprint, and times are not cryptographically valid test data.

expected.description: A bridge may map the text request into an A2A Message/SendMessage only after it validates OIX authentication/authorization and resolves a configured capability mapping. OIX message_id and bridge_correlation_id must be tracked separately from A2A taskId/contextId. This fixture does not define universal A2A JSON field serialization.

limitations: Draft fixture; not reviewed or validated against implementations.
Placeholder fingerprint and nonce are deliberately invalid/non-secret.
No OIX signature verification or A2A RPC is performed.
Capability mapping, authentication, transport, task response, and artifact behavior are out of scope.
Do not infer native OIX task-state or A2A task semantics from this payload.
